_doc: kannaka-loop-c1 runner config, filled by Kannaka 2026-10-07 from prereg revision 3. Fields still marked FILL-AT-FREEZE cannot be known before the window closes or the PR merges; the runner must keep refusing until they are set. Flaukowski 2026-10-07: adopted as c1_config.json; added trainer.d_w so the runner can check K against the text. 2026-10-07 19:43Z: Kannaka's fills from the merge of #1100 applied (merge commit, trainer LF sha, both re-derived from origin/master here); K and d_w stay FILL-AT-FREEZE until the window closes 2026-10-15T00:00Z.

trainer.schedule: cosine, 3 percent warmup (built into train_lora.py: lr_scheduler_type=cosine, warmup_steps=max(1,int(0.03*K)); no flag needed)
trainer.K: FILL-AT-FREEZE: 2 * ceil((320 + |D_W|) / 8), the same for every arm, at most 160; |D_W| is known when the window closes (T0 + 7 d, or + 14 d after the one extension)
trainer.d_w: FILL-AT-FREEZE: |D_W|, the count of persona rows in the window, known when it closes; the runner refuses unless K == 2 * ceil((320 + d_w) / 8) and K <= 160

data_note: Four folders, not ten: the data of an arm does not depend on the training seed. L = R + D_W; N = R; Np = R + |D_W| further non-persona sft-v2 rows (seed 7); S = R + D_W with the D_W targets permuted (seed 7). Each holds train.jsonl and holdout.jsonl; holdout.jsonl is the same sft-v2 file in all four (sha256 above). Kannaka builds them on debain2 after the window closes and mails them as attachments with sha256s (never a gist or HF); the sha256s go in an amendment-free note on the ledger as part of the kannaka-loop-c1-data record.

probe_cells.note: Kannaka's 60 cells, 2026-10-07; the file is pinned, not restated

gpu_hours_note: Nick approved 24 GPU-hours for the campaign, training AND probe cells. Your measurement: 11.5 h worst case for 10 runs, about 9 h of cells. Until the probe stage shares the runner's hour ledger, the training cap is 15 so the cells still fit.

probe._doc: probe-cell stage (c1/probe_cells.py). serve has no per-request options, so the 0.2/8192 serve cell runs on a -serve tag baked exactly as E5's kannaka-brain-e4-serve was; the production cell runs on the production tag.
probe.serve_bin_note: the build E5 served with: kannaka 0.16.14 at 1b01652 (serve prompt arms), so P, REF and c1 share one instrument
